sentences.text:
This application under Section 482 Cr.PC. has been filed by the applicants to quash the entire proceedings of Charge, sheet No. 308/2018 dated 31.08.2018 in case crime no. 0235/2018 Police Station-Eco Tach-III Dist.-Gautam Buddh Nagar Under Section 406, 420, 504, 506 I.P.C., In Case No. 929/2019 State V/S Idrish & Others, pending in the Court of Addl. Civil Judge. (S.D.), F.T.C.
Gautam Buddh Nagar.

entities.label: ORG

entities.text:
Court of Addl. Civil Judge. (S.D.), F.T.C.
Gautam Buddh Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: including the summoning order dated 26.03.2019.

4. Learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that a first information report was lodged under Sections 406, 420, 504, 506 IPC on 26.03.2018 being FIR No. 0235 of 2018 against the applicants with an allegation that with respect to a plot of land which was agreed to be sold pursuant to Rs. 50 notarized agreement, certain amount was advanced but registry was not being done.

Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the charge-sheet came to be submitted on 31.08.2018 and summoning order was passed on 26.03.2019 but the applicants was at no point of time served with the notice and thus he was completely unaware.
Learned counsel for the applicants submits that primarily the entire allegations centre around civil dispute which has been given criminal tinch.

He also seeks to rely upon the Hon'ble Apex Court in Delhi Race Club (1940) Ltd. and Others v. State of Uttar Pradesh and Another, Criminal Appeal No. 3114 of 2024 so as to contend that the ingredients under Sections 406 and 420 IPC are not attracted.

entities.text: Delhi Race Club (1940) Ltd. and Others v. State of Uttar Pradesh and Another, Criminal Appeal No. 3114 of 2024
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Learned AGA submits that the summoning order is dated 26.03.2019 and the charge-sheet is dated 31.08.2018 and approximately six years have passed.
He further submits that offences are made out from the allegations contained in the first information report and the charge-sheet.
Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the applicants shall be filing of a discharge application and till discharge application is decided, no coercive action shall be taken.

6. Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties including and bearing in mind the overall facts situation and the intervening circumstances, the application stands disposed of directing the applicants to submit a discharge application by 20.06.2025 and the said motion, the court below shall decide the same with most expedition.

7. Till the discharge application decided, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in pursuance of Charge, sheet No. 308/2018 dated 31.08.2018 in case crime no. 0235/2018 Police Station-Eco Tach-III Dist.-Gautam Buddh Nagar Under Section 406, 420, 504, 506 I.P.C., In Case No. 929/2019 State V/S Idrish & Others, pending in the Court of Addl. Civil Judge.
